messages.subject: Re: [GGIR]
parts:
Do you see multiple sleep estimates in the part 4 csv report?
If yes, then you are deriving multiple sleep estimates, maybe that is why. I do not think the visualreport is ready to handle that kind of output well. It is mainly designed to work with one sleep definition.

Try running GGIR with all default settings first to understand what is causing it.

Best,

Vincent
